title: Omurice
description: Japanese ketchup fried rice wrapped in a soft, buttery omelette.
steps: Melt half the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 2–3 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken with a pinch of the salt and the pepper; cook 4–5 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the peas.

Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, then stir in the ketchup and soy sauce. Fry 2–3 minutes until evenly coated and hot. Taste for salt, then divide between plates and shape each portion into an oval mound.
For each omelette, whisk 2 eggs with 1 tbsp milk and a pinch of salt.
Wipe the pan and melt half the remaining butter over medium heat. Pour in the eggs and stir quickly for 20–30 seconds, until set underneath but still glossy on top.
Slide the omelette over the rice mound (or tip the rice onto the omelette and fold it over). Repeat for the second plate.
Finish with a zigzag of ketchup and serve right away.
